title: The magic-link route hands a composed sign-in URL to the adapter and the adapter dispatches one message
asA: operator using a project that composed this blueprint alongside the magic-link blueprint
iWant: the auth flow's mint step to call the adapter's send method and see a real message go out
soThat: sign-in works on the deployed application without a project-authored provider shim

acceptanceCriteria.description: The adapter exposes exactly the send method owned on TAC-401-email-smtp-resend-send-adapter.interfaces.send (shape-compatible with the magic-link blueprint's TAC-504) as the sole auth-facing method.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the adapter module imported into a running process
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process enumerates the adapter's exported surface
acceptanceCriteria.then: the enumeration returns `send` as the sole async method and no other public method matches the auth-facing shape

acceptanceCriteria.description: A successful send resolves the outcome record owned on TAC-401-email-smtp-resend-send-adapter.interfaces.send in its success shape (per that interface's contract).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project with valid configuration and a recipient the provider accepts
acceptanceCriteria.when: the magic-link route calls the adapter's send interface defined on `TAC-401-email-smtp-resend-send-adapter.interfaces.send`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned object matches the success shape owned on TAC-401-email-smtp-resend-send-adapter.interfaces.send

acceptanceCriteria.description: Exactly one SMTP submission is dispatched per adapter call on the successful path; the adapter does not fan out to duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project instrumented to count SMTP submissions
acceptanceCriteria.when: the magic-link route triggers one adapter send
acceptanceCriteria.then: the submission counter increments by exactly one and no additional submission is observed within the retry window
